fixes.explanation: Let's look at where this verse lands, friend. Jesus says to sell everything he owns and give to the poor, and treasure in heaven comes next. Then He ends with, "Then come, follow Me." That's the invitation I'd frame on my bakery wall, right next to my favorite apron. No priests in this verse, just the poor.
